name: t23-g3-traversal
description: T23 / G3 row 8b — traverse away and back with residency on. One walkable 30 m lane, two players. Client 0 walks +X across ~2 brick columns and part-way back while running a client-side terrain-residency pass (evict behind, reload in front via RepairRequest). Client 1 is stationary and severs a run of floor at the far end (x=25 m) while client 0 has that brick evicted, so client 0 gaps, repairs, and re-applies. The server also runs residency. All participants, the exact replay, and the cold restart must converge to one canonical hash: evicting and reloading terrain along a player path is invisible to logical topology.
